description: This file defines interfaces for concurrent grains within an Orleans project, specifically IConcurrentGrain and IConcurrentReentrantGrain, which are used to facilitate concurrent and reentrant grain interactions.

classes.name: IConcurrentGrain
classes.description: An interface extending IGrainWithIntegerKey, providing async methods for initialization, modifications, and tail calls involving concurrent operations.

classes.name: IConcurrentReentrantGrain
classes.description: An interface extending IGrainWithIntegerKey, providing async methods for initialization and tail calls with reentrant behavior.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the concurrent grain with a given index.

methods.name: A
methods.description: Returns an integer asynchronously, possibly marked as read-only.

methods.name: B
methods.description: Returns an integer asynchronously, taking a 'time' parameter, possibly marked as read-only.

methods.name: ModifyReturnList_Test
methods.description: Returns a list of integers asynchronously, likely used for test modifications.

methods.name: Initialize_2 (IConcurrentGrain)
methods.description: Second initialization method with an index parameter.

methods.name: TailCall_Caller
methods.description: Performs a tail call to another concurrent reentrant grain.

methods.name: TailCall_Resolver
methods.description: Resolves a tail call to another concurrent reentrant grain.

methods.name: Initialize_2 (IConcurrentReentrantGrain)
methods.description: Initializes the reentrant grain with an index.

methods.name: TailCall_Called
methods.description: Performs a tail call to resolve a call in reentrant context.

methods.name: TailCall_Resolve
methods.description: Resolves a tail call in reentrant context.
